  \caption[{Measured resistance against gain code at all five corners, \SI{500}{\nano\ampere} forced through the A--B\,\dots}]{Measured resistance against gain code at all five corners, \SI{500}{\nano\ampere} forced through the A--B terminals with B held at \(V_{\mathrm{CM}}=\SI{1.25}{\volt}\).
